property_summary: For any timestamps t1 <= t2 and any caller, once C accepts a 10-ether fallback call at t1, any further fallback call at a timestamp t2 not strictly greater than the last accepted timestamp must revert; the mutant dropped this guard so a second call at the same timestamp succeeds.
change_summary: Remove the timestamp guard so calls in the same block.timestamp also succeed and update pastBlockTime.
